title: 第十三章 两辈子都没见过这么大的狼
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

世界安静了一秒。

准确地说，是姜枝脑子安静了一秒。

她整个人都傻了。

暗红近黑的鳞片覆在庞大的身躯上，每一片都泛着冷硬光泽，巨大的利爪像能轻易把人撕成两半，喉咙里滚动的火光越来越亮，热浪扑面而来，烤得她睫毛都像要卷起来。

姜枝重生才第二天，没来得及把三层小洋房掏出来住。

难道就要交代在这里？！

系统在脑子里都快破音了：

【宿主快跑喵！！！∑(っ°Д°;)っ】

问题是她腿软啊。

不仅是因为怕，还因为昨晚某人实在有点过于给力，她现在膝盖一磕，腿根那股酸劲儿顿时更明显了，别说飞奔，她能爬起来都算身体素质过硬。

火翼龙已经低下头，那双竖瞳冰冷地锁住了她。

而与此同时，远处高地上，正往回赶的一道身影猛地顿住了。

苍凛是听见警报后折返回来的。

他本来不想靠近姜枝。

更不想让自己看起来像是被她几句话伤了以后，还放心不下地回来找她。

结果他刚从崖坡上跃下来，一眼就看见了那一幕。

那个平时懒得多走两步路、动不动就装死摆烂、在他印象里最会惜命也最会折腾人的姜枝，竟然扑出去，把一个素不相识的小崽子推开了，自己暴露在了龙的面前。

是意外吗？

苍凛确信恶雌绝不会为了援救他人，而让自己陷入危险。

如今，苍凛只要要什么都不做，只要站在这里，看着火焰落下。

根本不用再等三个月冷静期，所有的屈辱都能一笔勾销。

婚姻关系解除后，他可以拿回自己的尊严，回到狼族之中，再也不用被困在那个山洞里，再也不用听恶雌的命令，再也不用做她随手折辱的兽夫。

可就在龙的火光亮起时，苍凛的爪子已经陷进了地面。

他猛一发力，高高跃起。

哪怕他打不过火翼龙。

哪怕恶雌从来没有真正喜欢过他。

哪怕她用那只刚摸过他的手，去抓别的尾巴。

巨狼一跃而下，灰黑色的身影带着腥热的风，直直扑向那头俯冲而来的火翼龙。

“轰——”

火翼龙被撞得偏开半截，喉咙里那团火也跟着歪了方向，擦着姜枝身侧喷出去。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The world was quiet for a second.

To be precise, Jiang Zhi's mind was quiet for a second.

She was completely stunned.

Dark red and almost black scales covered the huge body, each one with a cold and hard luster. The huge claws seemed to be able to easily tear a person in half. The fire rolling in her throat became brighter and brighter, and the heat wave hit her face, making her eyelashes seem to curl up.

It was only the second day after Jiang Zhi was reborn that he didn't have time to take out a three-story bungalow to live in.

Do I have to explain it here?!

The system is almost broken in my head:

[Host, run away, meow!!!∑(っ°Д°;)っ】

The problem is that her legs are weak.

Not only because of fear, but also because someone was a little too strong last night. Now she knocked her knee, and the soreness in her legs suddenly became more obvious. Let alone running, she was considered to be in good physical condition if she could get up.

The Fire Winged Dragon had lowered his head, and his vertical pupils locked her coldly.

At the same time, on the high ground in the distance, a figure rushing back suddenly stopped.

Cang Lin turned back after hearing the alarm.

He originally didn't want to get close to Jiang Zhi.

He didn't even want to look like he was hurt by a few words from her, but he still came back to find her uneasily.

As a result, he just jumped down from the cliff and saw that scene at a glance.

Jiang Zhi, who was usually too lazy to take an extra step, always pretending to be dead, and who in his impression was the most life-saving and tormenting person, actually jumped out and pushed a stranger away, exposing himself to the dragon.

Was it an accident?

Cang Lin is convinced that the evil female will never put herself in danger in order to save others.

Now, all Cang Lin wants to do is stand here and watch the flames fall.

There is no need to wait for the three-month cooling-off period, and all the humiliation can be wiped out.

After the marriage was dissolved, he could take back his dignity and return to the wolf clan. He would no longer have to be trapped in that cave, no longer have to listen to the evil female's orders, and no longer had to be the beast husband she casually humiliated.

But just as the dragon's fire lit up, Cang Lin's claws had already sunk into the ground.

He exerted force and leaped high into the air.

Even if he can't defeat the Fire Winged Dragon.

Even if the evil female never really liked him.

Even if she uses the hand that just touched him to grab other tails.

The giant wolf jumped down, its gray-black figure carrying the hot wind, and rushed straight towards the swooping Fire Winged Dragon.

"Boom——"

The fire winged dragon was knocked half aside, and the fire in its throat also deflected, grazing Jiang Zhi's side and spraying out.
